desc: Derive the correct O(N log N) algorithm: sort by X_i - Y_i, then for each possible split of the sorted array into two groups (left and right), compute the best total using the remaining two components (Y and Z) via similar two-component logic, and take the maximum over splits.
Implement the algorithm in Python with O(N log N) per test case, handling the sum of N over test cases up to 1e5.
Test the implementation on the provided samples and additional edge cases (e.g., N=2, K=1; all components equal; large values).
